course: In the previous years, they were teaching R in the first half of the course and the midterm exam, which is the only major exam in the course, was from R. In the second half of the course they were teaching the biology part where the mbg students clearly have a massive advantage. But the final exam is mostly take home so even if the student is not from MBG, s/he can take his/her time and do well on the final exam. This year however, we had biology on the first half of the term and we had the midterm on the biology part of this course. The midterm was extremely difficult for non-MBG students and easy for the MBG students. Even though it was open notes, there wasn't nearly enough time to look up the lecture notes to find the relevant thing you need. So in the end, in the only major examination in this course, all MBG students did very well and non-MBG students failed. And the other assignments are completed by everybody, with MBG students maybe finishing earlier than non-MBG students. So overall, MBG students should get an A from this course easily and unless you can memorized hundreds of pages of lecture slides, a non-MBG student cannot get an A. If you are an MBG student, this might be the best course to take from you, you will have an easy time while all the non-MBG students suffer and do worse than you. But if you are a non-MBG student, this course is designed for you to suffer, and most likely not get an A.
